newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.
newsitem.headline: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.

text.p: Vacant space in Canadian Prairie primary grain elevators averaged 28 percent in the week ended Aug 17, said Canadian Wheat Board.
Manitoba elevators showed the most space at 37 percent followed by Alberta at 33 percent and Saskatchewan had 21 percent of space available.

Vancouver unloaded 2,882 railcars versus the 3,300 target. Prince Rupert unloaded 1,221 railcars versus the 1,200 target. Thunder Bay unloaded 3,369 railcars versus the 3,500 target and Churchill unloaded 430 railcars.
